mvps.tagline: TikTok-native series: 60-second explainers of every government service Uzbeks need to know, from kindergarten enrollment to inheritance

underlying_demand.pain_point: Younger Uzbek adults (Gen Z, 18-30) consume TikTok over text. Existing government communications are PDFs or static articles. No bilingual TikTok creator covers public services.

mvps.target_customer: Uzbek Gen Z (18-30), urban and small-city, encountering adult bureaucracy for the first time (apartment leases, marriages, first jobs)

build_steps: Record 30 60-second explainers in 2 weeks (founder + cousin/friend on camera)
Post 1 video/day across TikTok + Instagram Reels + YouTube Shorts
Monetize via TikTok Creator Fund + brand deals (TBC, Anorbank, Uzcard)
Affiliate links to bank account opening + insurance
Soft-launch via cross-promo with 3 mid-size UZ creators

validation.signal_target: 10K TikTok followers + 2 brand deal inquiries in 60 days

mvps.moat_potential: Audience + brand becomes a launchpad for paid course or app; brand deals compound.

risk_register.mitigation: Multi-platform from day 1
Batch 30 videos per session, post on schedule
Lean on direct sponsor deals

scoring.scoring_rationale: Brand play, slower monetization.

mvps.tagline: Squeeze page + Telegram bot reminding citizens of upcoming local mahalla elections, with candidate list and polling station map

underlying_demand.pain_point: Mahalla raisi and local council elections happen on staggered schedules. Citizens often miss polling. There is no aggregated voter-info tool. UNDP-supported transparency initiatives create grant alignment.

mvps.target_customer: Civic-active mahalla residents 25-50 across Tashkent districts who want to vote informedly in mahalla elections

build_steps: Aggregate polling-station data from district hokimiyat sites
Carrd page + Telegram bot for reminders
Add candidate list scraped from official channels
UNDP-aligned grant pitch ($15-30K)
Soft-launch in spot.uz civic chat

validation.signal_target: 1,000 reminder signups by next election cycle

mvps.moat_potential: Civic-tech grant continuity; can extend to national elections cycle.

risk_register.mitigation: Stay neutral, no candidate endorsement
Use only published sources
Lean on partner NGOs for distribution

scoring.scoring_rationale: Civic value, weak monetization, political risk.

mvps.tagline: Manifesto + paid masterclass: how to win your first xt-xarid.uz tender as an SME in 90 days

underlying_demand.pain_point: First-time tender bidders fail at 80%+ rates due to format errors, missing documentation, mispricing. xt-xarid.uz publishes 200/day. UP-189 is creating a wave of new IT tenders that newcomers are unprepared for.

mvps.target_customer: Tashkent and Samarkand IT consultancies, equipment dealers, and construction firms (5-30 employees) who have never won a state tender

build_steps: Write 4,000-word manifesto: 'Why most Uzbek SMEs lose tenders and how to fix it'
Cross-post on LinkedIn, Habr, Spot.uz business blog
Convert into a $99 video masterclass (4 modules)
Substack-style email funnel
Soft-launch via TBC SME Telegram and IT Park UZ Telegram

validation.signal_target: 200 manifesto reads + 25 paid masterclass purchases in 60 days

mvps.moat_potential: Authority brand on UZ procurement; alumni community becomes an SaaS upsell audience for TenderRadar UZ.

risk_register.mitigation: Cross-promo with TenderRadar UZ MVP

risk_register.risk: Refund risk if course quality lacking
risk_register.mitigation: 30-day money-back, transparent rubric

risk_register.risk: Outdated content as procurement law evolves
risk_register.mitigation: Quarterly update commitment

scoring.scoring_rationale: Brand-authority + course bundle, complementary to TenderRadar UZ.

mvps.tagline: Wizard-of-Oz service helping retired Uzbeks check, transfer, and dispute pension entitlements via Pension Fund e-services

underlying_demand.pain_point: Pension Fund Uzbekistan moved to e-services but most retirees (3M+ in active receipt) struggle with the portal. Their adult children call the call center on their behalf, often during work hours. Spot.uz forum 'pension digital' threads run constantly.

mvps.target_customer: Adult children (35-55) in Tashkent and Andijan supporting parents (60-80) with pension matters, especially after a parent's residency move or spouse death

build_steps: Compile top 10 pension-related tasks (transfer, dispute, certificate)
Telegram bot intake + power-of-attorney template
Founder + 1 student handle backend within 24h
Click payment, 150,000 UZS per task
Cross-post in Andijan parent groups + spot.uz seniors community

validation.signal_target: 15 paid tasks in 30 days

mvps.moat_potential: Productize into a $30/year pension-management subscription service for adult children of retirees; align with WB social protection program.

risk_register.mitigation: Partner with one Tashkent notary for template review
Bundle with FormFiller UZ to share fulfillment ops
Limit to verified family-relation submissions

scoring.scoring_rationale: Real pain, paying customers via adult children, partnership upside with WB.
